Meanwhile, you drive the reach truck through the warehouse to place pallets in the correct spot. Thanks to your efforts, the warehouse remains organized and the process runs smoothly. Do you enjoy working actively and do you like a mix of driving and physical labor? Then this role as a Warehouse Employee is for you.

 What will you do? 
As a Warehouse Employee, you are responsible for picking and processing orders in the warehouse. You work with pick lists and ensure that products are correctly prepared for shipment on time. 
You regularly operate the reach truck to retrieve pallets from the racks and bring them to the correct picking locations. Additionally, you place pallets back into the racks when necessary. You are also involved in loading and unloading trucks and ensure that goods are stored in the correct place. 
During your work activities, you perform quality checks and identify any deviations. You register orders in the system and contribute to a neat, safe, and organized work environment.
